readerCopy.body: A simple preference can carry far more heat when wanting something different has a history of punishment or rejection. When Chiron squares Lilith, sensitivity and refusal create friction, making a present no carry more force than the current decision alone explains. A broader frustration can surface around the old bargain that said approval depended on staying agreeable, easy, or quiet. The anger is not random, but the current person or decision cannot repair every earlier loss attached to it. Today's boundary becomes more useful once it is allowed to belong to today.
